title: Wren and the Garden
author: Orsen Fairweather
blurb: Quentin Eastwick, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent fifteen years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
